Chapter 6954: Your Killer

Chapter 6954: Your Killer

Killing immortals was no easy task. The most basic requirement was to obliterate their true fate in the blink of an eye.

Breaker’s Death Reversal could do something like that. It surpassed physical damage and struck the roots instead.

If a primordial immortal couldn’t block it successfully, it could result in death or grievous damage to their grand dao. Of course, Breaker paid a heavy price to carry it out - all of his primordial power.

“Pop!” Li Qiye took the hit directly as if he were not aware of its effect.

All eyes fixated on him, wanting to see the consequences. At the very least, it should send him flying or knock him to the ground.

Alas, only smoke emanated around him, nothing more. This froze spectators in place.

“Impossible...” Apex murmured since he understood this technique the best. If struck, he would have had to abandon his body and take epochs to recover. Only a few primordial immortals could survive this.

The most shaken was none other than Breaker himself. He had used it to kill a primordial immortal before. His goal was to slow Li Qiye for a moment, giving him enough time to escape.

He didn’t believe in ghosts, nor did he fear them. Alas, he feared this mortal.

“Just who are you?!” He asked while being horrified.

“Your killer.” Li Qiye smiled and approached.

Although he knew struggling was useless, he still wanted to fight. He turned all of his lifespan and vitality into death again for another shot.

“Crack!” Li Qiye swung and shattered the beams.

Before he could regain his wits, Li Qiye appeared behind him. He couldn’t move an inch as Li Qiye drained the remaining vitality and powers from him.

“Ahh!” He bellowed in pain.

The first to be drained was his true fate. However, Li Qiye took it slow, only draining singular strands at a time. The same happened to his lifespan and true blood.

He was conscious the whole time during the draining process. Once that was finished, refinement came next.
